easy.def: An African antelope with twisted horns.

more.def: A large African antelope with white stripes and long, spiraling horns.
examples: The male kudu has long, spiral horns.
A kudu grazed at the edge of the bush.
The kudu leaped over the fence.

easy.def: A tiny orange fruit you eat whole.

more.def: A small, orange fruit shaped like an olive, eaten whole, skin and all.
examples: A kumquat is small and tangy.
The kumquat tree had many fruits.
